newsitem.title: USA: Armor Holdings acquires DSL Group.
newsitem.headline: Armor Holdings acquires DSL Group.

text.p: Armor Holdings Inc said Wednesday it acquired DSL Group Ltd, a leading provider of specialist security services, for $26.0 million in cash and stock.
Armor Holdings said it expects the deal to more than double its base of operations and be accretive for its shareholders.
Armor said the $26 million purchase price includes $10.9 million in Armor stock and $7.6 million in cash. Armor will also pay $7.5 million of term debt.
The deal will be accounted for on a "pooling of interests" basis.

DSL's, which based in London, had 1996 revenues of about $36.2 million with operating profits of about $2.9 million. Its core business is devising and implementing solutions to complex security problems in high risk areas around the world.
"The acquisition of DSL provides Armor Holdings with the cornerstone of its security services business," said Jonathan Spiller, president and chief executive of Armor Holdings.
DSL will continue to be managed by Alastair Morrison, Chairman and Richard Bethell, Chief Executive.

Armor Holdings manufactures products and services for the law enforcement, military and security markets. The company provides ballistic protection and security equipment, less-than-lethal and anti-riot products, and other public safety products including narcotic identification kits.
